both_one_process.same_process_note: READ THIS BEFORE COMPARING RSS. The `*_fresh_process` sections are the RSS evidence: each arm ran in its own process, so ru_maxrss is that arm's true peak. In THIS in-process head-to-head the before arm runs FIRST and CPython does not return its memory to the OS, so `after.rss_start_mb` is already high and `after.rss_peak_mb` can be at or near the before arm's peak — do not read this section's RSS as the after arm's footprint. An independent reviewer made exactly that misattribution on 2026-10-20 and returned REFUTED against numbers that are in a different section. WALL TIME in this section IS comparable (same process, same ids, back to back).
